metrics_indoor.data: SDT real indoor thermal frames (FLIR Lepton 3.5): people lying, sitting, standing, plus empty floor; the held-out 20% of every recording block

calibration.note: ECE = average gap between confidence and how often the model is right (0 is perfectly honest).

curve_note: Curve of the shipped model (logged retrain, promoted because it scored equal or better).

paths: file paths are relative to /ai-lab/results/ (DZ_AI_LAB=1); runtime paths start with /crops/
note: Examples and metrics are held-out FLIR images (val and video test splits), never used in training. Examples are curated for a collapsed-building search: one person in a sitting, crouching or bent pose, or a warm object filling the frame.

decoys.source: Teledyne FLIR ADAS v2 thermal, images_thermal_val + video_thermal_test (never trained on); frames used by the runtime crops, unsure pairs and the held-out test set excluded
decoys.note: dog and sunlit are real counterparts; the other five are stand-ins (warmest crops of the closest labelled class), named as such in each caption

examples.shows: sun-warmed pavement or wall, real FLIR thermal frame (no label: a bright patch away from every labelled object)
running truck engine and machinery (stand-in for a generator)
warm car front (stand-in for a space heater)
lamp post or light housing (stand-in for a hot pipe)
boxy warm bus panel (stand-in for a server rack)
small warm panel (stand-in for a laptop)
